messages.subject: Disclosure review session - Hartwell v Cryovance (proposed dates)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Ahead of the 26 June disclosure deadline, Sarah would like to hold a review session to walk through Cryovance's disclosed vehicle, driver and CAPA records once received. Could you let me know your availability across 1-3 July? We expect to need around two hours, by video.

Kind regards,
Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant, Whitfield Carter LLP
